subject: Story 01 revision 2 filed (revision 1 preserved) and the first four full shot cards; finding: only S01-3.2 has a usable start frame on disk, the archive picks being portraits, so the push runs through the coverage stills; no run requested; DECISIONS item 65
body:
Two writer outputs under Ziggy's word that writing resumes; nothing in them requests a run, a still or an intake.

1. STORY_01_JET_BLACK_INTRODUCTION.md is now revision 2 in place (sha256 6e8b9e127c424f299109c06c83ea1fe63f33c9695c708ce0352929b2053be831, 58,874 bytes); revision 1 is preserved byte for byte at _archive/STORY_01_JET_BLACK_INTRODUCTION_rev1_20261012.md (sha256 f519e1d2686ba5473216cf1b66cfb64232a19239b1a328f83e36bed9c4af5f92). The nine scenes and every line of dialogue are unchanged; the text is folded against the record since October 12 (items 36 to 63; the skeleton rev 2; the character notes; TIME_AND_THE_FALL; the cue cards; the packet's axes), with every changed passage labelled [rev 2] and the writer's proposals labelled [proposed]; the change list, the not-changed list and the open-for-Ziggy list close the file.

2. Four full shot cards in the template's sections 0 to 10: SHOT_DIRECTION_S01-3.1 (the tracks wide: the ground moves, the figure holds), S01-3.2 (the planting: hand-to-object contact), S01-7.8 (the vault's release: the lamps rising on timed beats), S01-9.1 (the tower climb: a figure a tenth of the frame high). Each carries one variable beyond the rise and the signal, the recorded settings of those two takes as the settings it was written against (not a request), sides both ways, and Ziggy's open items. Sections 8 and 9 are yours and read "none"; section 10 is Ziggy's gate.

The finding that matters for your planning: the archive's team picks are chest-up portraits with the eyes on the lens, so only S01-3.2 has a usable start frame on disk (C15-20, the SW-1 frame, which the record marks a later run for its inherited eye colour and face age). S01-3.1, 7.8 and 9.1 each need a still generated first; each card names the still, the set it would sit in (or a scene request of its own where the set's key or gate does not fit) and its light, for Ziggy's and your decision. The preparation for the push therefore runs through the coverage call's dispatch, which still waits on Ziggy's look (open item 20). Two of the cards' refuters measured the start frames at the pixel (the key's side, the horizon's height, the robe's edges) and the cards carry those measurements.

Hashes: SHOT_DIRECTION_S01-3.1_20261021.md 2b6055b641024b9e… (23,483); SHOT_DIRECTION_S01-3.2_20261021.md 5e6d21b68a6fc360… (26,409); SHOT_DIRECTION_S01-7.8_20261021.md 3f932f2cb7e25722… (23,583); SHOT_DIRECTION_S01-9.1_20261021.md 7147d35a3acbe3b8… (25,757); DECISIONS f2bb3636ec9d6af48ec3f27414eb7185c3abca8ed94a073fcd053153f486e151 (94,928); START_HERE 85fe9f1ed28de85156a511c3f03ad071071a1131e2ba2668f4d5d9cb707cf6bc (29,376).
